item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Creates a temp `custom_module.py`, adds its directory to `sys.path`, imports `custom_module`, instantiates `MyModule`, and saves with `save_program=True`."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"First save omits `modules_to_serialize`, then removes the module from `sys.modules` and `sys.path`, and catches `ModuleNotFoundError` from `dspy.load(..., allow_pickle=True)`."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Second save uses `save(..., save_program=True, modules_to_serialize=[custom_module])`, matching the by-value serialization path described in the evidence."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"After re-saving, it again removes the import path/module, successfully loads, and asserts the nested predictor signature matches the original program."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
